sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "issuer" TEXT NULL, "issued_at" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "card_type" TEXT NULL, "needs_completion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_completion" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("quantity" > 0), "acquired_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_items (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "derived_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_cover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_cover" IN (0, 1)), "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_count" INTEGER NULL, "count_known" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("count_known" IN (0, 1)), "issue_info" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cover_image_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES card_images (id), "cover_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((count_known = 0 AND expected_count IS NULL) OR (count_known = 1 AND expected_count > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_set_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_sets (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "member_no" TEXT NULL, "required" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("required" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_tags" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "definition_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_cards" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series_records (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id", "definition_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_sets" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series_records (id), "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_sets (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id", "set_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_values" ("field_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_field_definitions (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "text_value" TEXT NULL, "number_value" REAL NULL, "date_value" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("field_id", "definition_id"), CHECK ((text_value IS NOT NULL) + (number_value IS NOT NULL) + (date_value IS NOT NULL) = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchased_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "shipping_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fees_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "channel" TEXT NULL, "seller" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "adjustment_of_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((adjustment_of_id IS NULL AND amount_minor >= 0 AND shipping_minor >= 0 AND fees_minor >= 0) OR (adjustment_of_id IS NOT NULL AND amount_minor < 0 AND shipping_minor = 0 AND fees_minor = 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "allocated_minor" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("purchase_id", "target_type", "target_id"), CHECK (allocated_minor IS NULL OR allocated_minor >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("numerator" > 0), "denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("denominator" > 0), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("base_currency", "quote_currency", "rate_date", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recycle_bin_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retention_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (retention_days IN (7, 30, 90)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_cleanup_queue" ("relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("relative_path"), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "cursor" TEXT NULL, "account_user_id" TEXT NULL, "account_email" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_entity_states" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type", "entity_id"), CHECK (server_version >= 0), CHECK ((deleted = 0 AND payload_json IS NOT NULL) OR (deleted = 1 AND payload_json IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "changed_fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"), CHECK (operation IN ('upsert', 'delete')), CHECK (base_server_version >= 0), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), CHECK ((operation = 'upsert' AND payload_json IS NOT NULL) OR (operation = 'delete' AND payload_json IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "remote_operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "remote_server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "conflicting_fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (local_operation IN ('upsert', 'delete')), CHECK (remote_operation IN ('upsert', 'delete')), CHECK (remote_server_version > 0));
